description: This file defines a plugin class for detecting GitLab secrets within code by matching specific regex patterns. It extends a base detector class and provides properties for secret type and denylist regex patterns for various GitLab tokens.

classes.name: GitLabDetector
classes.description: A detector class that scans for GitLab secrets using regex patterns, extending the base regex detector.

methods.name: str secret_type(self)
methods.description: Returns the type of secret this detector is designed to find, which is 'GitLab Secret'.

methods.name: list[re.Pattern] denylist(self)
methods.description: Provides a list of compiled regex patterns that match various GitLab tokens, including personal access tokens, pipeline trigger tokens, and runner registration tokens.
